name: B10-0121/2026 (Renew) – Post-election situation in Uganda and threats against opposition leader Bobi Wine
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the post-election situation in Uganda and threats against opposition leader Bobi Wine
part_text:
**What it asks for**

The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion on Uganda's January 2026 elections and what followed. It condemns violence and arrests against opposition supporters, including leader Bobi Wine, and the killing of Mesach Okello. It asks Uganda's government to stop harassment, free people held without good reason, allow independent courts, end internet shutdowns and reform its election system. It also asks the European Union and its member states to review how they work with Uganda.

**Three points**

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. This is the Parliament's opinion and a set of demands to Uganda.
- **Who it affects:** Uganda's government, opposition figures, journalists and civil society, plus European Union cooperation with Uganda.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to European Union bodies, Uganda's authorities and the African Union.
